text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Veridian-prod private VPC - NLB target group failing healthchecks, spike in 502/503 from dedicated pool-a. Started ~2026-03-16T21:08Z. Pager routed to @oncall-sre. Incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/incidents/runbooks/vpc-egress

oncall-sre: Taking this. Paging netops - @netops-alex can you join? Any visible customer impact?

netops-alex: Joining. Quick checks: target-health shows 40% unhealthy in pool-a, AZ-b most affected. SG rules look unchanged. Route tables fine. Pulling node logs now.

kevin-sre: seeing conntrack counts high on nodes in pool-a, NAT sessions near conntrack_max. `ss -s` shows many TIME_WAIT and `cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count` high.

netops-alex: Repro locally: curl to private NLB endpoint -> 502. ALB->backend direct is OK. Looks like NLB healthchecks failing intermittently for target group tg-veridian-pool-a.

oncall-sre: Action plan: shift traffic off pool-a to avoid customer errors. Updating Route53 weighted record for `priv-vip.veridian.internal` - set pool-a weight=0, pool-b weight=100. Executing now.

customer-eng-jordan: Notified Veridian support that we're investigating and performing traffic shift. They reported errors starting ~21:08 UTC and some customer requests failing.

netops-alex: After weight change, traffic flows to pool-b. Also modified target-group attributes and restarted healthcheck agents on pool-a nodes. Ran: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:...tg-veridian-pool-a` and `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --attributes Key=stickiness.enabled,Value=false` to force re-eval.

kevin-sre: Temporary mitigation: cleared conntrack table on pool-a nodes: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=300` and `sudo -n bash -c "echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_flush"` (applied carefully). Observed immediate drop in conntrack_count.

lia-product: Metrics update: error rate for Veridian drops from 18% -> 1.2% after shift. Latency stable. Pool-b healthy. Recommend keeping shift until root cause confirmed.

oncall-sre: Agreed. Keep pool-a weight=0. I'll open a CR to follow up on kernel conntrack tuning and investigate any traffic patterns causing NAT exhaustion. Postmortem owners: @oncall-sre, @netops-alex.

account-exec-maya: FYI I'm on call with Veridian execs. They'll want an RCA and timeline for remediation. Can we commit to a preliminary RCA by tomorrow EOD?

oncall-sre: Yes — preliminary RCA and mitigation timeline by EOD tomorrow. Full postmortem in 3 business days.

incident-bot: Incident status -> RESOLVED. Root mitigation: traffic shifted to pool-b, conntrack flushed on pool-a, healthchecks restored. Postmortem assigned. Incident ID veridian-privnet-egress-6150001234. Thanks everyone :tada:
